items.content_html:
Description

Add a Handler_methods entry to L10n-Common.json with translations for de, en-US, es, fr, ja, ko, ru, zh-CN.

Motivation

Used by rari's JS reference sidebar for a new "Handler methods" group on Proxy/* pages (see mdn/rari#728). Without this key, l10n_json_data returns an error and the affected sidebar build fails.

Additional details

Translations were sourced from established usage in the existing Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Proxy/Proxy/** pages of translated-content and translated-content-de. Each mirrors the locale's existing "X methods" pattern (e.g. Instance_methods → "Méthodes d'instance" ⇒ "Méthodes du gestionnaire"; German "Handler-Funktionen" ⇒ "Handler-Methoden").

pt-BR and zh-TW are omitted because the source content is not translated in those locales; they will fall back to en-US.

Related issues and pull requests

Related to mdn/rari#728.
items.title: chore(jsondata): add `Handler_methods` L10n key

The original description was not incorrect but a slight change in order and better description and comparison with normal behaviour should make the uscase a bit clearer

Specifically, it adds:

  • An Element.startViewTransition() ref page
  • An Element.activeViewTransition ref page
  • A ViewTransition.transitionRoot ref page
  • A view-transition-scope ref page

Motivation

items.content_html:
Dear maintainer — this PR has a permanent home with methodology + opt-out at tokens-for-good. A one-line "no thanks" → auto-close + blacklist. Sorry for the notification this edit caused.

Heads-up: I realise this PR may not be welcome here. It was prepared
by an AI agent (Cursor / Claude Opus 4.7) running unattended under
@adv0r as a small personal token-burn initiative. I deliberately
picked a low-impact, easy-to-review, narrowly-scoped change so a
maintainer can either land it in a minute or close it with zero
guilt. No hard feelings either way — just trying to be useful while
spending some leftover Cursor credits before the billing cycle ends.

What

Fix a duplicate the in the HTMLImageElement: sizes reference page — the the selected image → the selected image.

Why

Reads cleanly on the rendered page.

How verified

Single-character/word change, no rendered structure altered. Read the surrounding paragraph and the new sentence still parses unambiguously.

Maintainer note

Feel free to close if not worth the review cycle.
items.title: docs(HTMLImageElement.sizes): fix duplicate "the"

items.content_html:
Description

JPEG-XL is now supported in Firefox Beta and Developer Edition (found out through my own testing).

Motivation

This will allow readers to be informed about the state of the format's support, which is relevant because of the data savings the format can enable.

Additional details

Since Firefox 152 Stable has not come out yet, I'm not sure if its row should be filled out or left blank, but the other rows should definitely be updated since the versions in those rows (Beta and Developer Edition) have been released.

Related issues and pull requests

None that I could find.
items.title: Add update on JPEG-XL support
